title: Find the Minimum Area to Cover All Ones I
summary: Given a 2D binary array, determine the smallest rectangle that encloses all '1's, and report its area.
statement: Given a 2D binary array, determine the smallest rectangle that encloses all '1's, and report its area.
constraints: grid is a nonempty rectangular binary matrix containing at least one one.
Choose one axis-aligned rectangle whose cells include every one; zero cells may also lie inside.
Return the smallest possible rectangle area.
target_space_complexity: O(number of ones) in this implementation
hints: Any covering rectangle must include the extreme row and column containing a one.
Scan all ones and track minimum and maximum row and column.
The extremes force these four boundaries, and their bounding rectangle covers every intervening one, so it is minimal.
editorial: The extremes force these four boundaries, and their bounding rectangle covers every intervening one, so it is minimal.

tests.explanation: The ones span both rows and all three columns, so the bounding rectangle area is six.
A one-cell rectangle around the only one has area one.
